name: WCT Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，WCT Holdings Berhad 完成将 Bukit Tinggi Shopping Centre、Paradigm Mall Petaling Jaya 和 Paradigm Mall Johor Bahru 出售给 Paradigm REIT，总代价 RM2,437.00 million，并完成 Paradigm REIT 的设立与上市；同时通过 WCT Land Sdn Bhd 以 RM140.00 million 收购 Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd 剩余 30% 股权，使其成为全资子公司。
overview_en: In 2026, WCT Holdings Berhad completed the disposal of Bukit Tinggi Shopping Centre, Paradigm Mall Petaling Jaya and Paradigm Mall Johor Bahru to Paradigm REIT for a total consideration of RM2,437.00 million, and completed the establishment and listing of Paradigm REIT; it also acquired the remaining 30% equity interest in Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd through WCT Land Sdn Bhd for RM140.00 million, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary.

segments.name: 物业投资与管理
segments.note: 今年完成将三个购物中心出售给 Paradigm REIT，并完成该 REIT 的设立与上市。
segments.note_en: This year completed the disposal of three shopping centres to Paradigm REIT and completed the establishment and listing of the REIT.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 买卖协议已于 2025 年 6 月 10 日完成，出售代价 RM2,437.00 million 已结算。
actions.text_en: The SPAs were completed on 10 June 2025, and the disposal consideration of RM2,437.00 million was settled.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO (I) PROPOSED DISPOSALS BY THE RESPECTIVE VENDORS OF BUKIT TINGGI SHOPPING CENTRE, PARADIGM MALL PETA
actions.text: 总代价 RM2,437.00 million，以 1,600,000,000 个新单位（每单位 RM1.00）及现金 RM837.00 million 支付。
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal of Bukit Tinggi Shopping Centre, Paradigm Mall Petaling Jaya and Paradigm Mall Johor Bahru to RHB Trustees Berhad (on behalf of Paradigm REIT) for a total consideration of RM2,437.00 million, satisfied via 1,600,000,000 new units at RM1.00 pe…

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Paradigm REIT 于 2025 年 3 月 13 日设立，卖方与 RHB Trustee 于同日签订买卖协议，出售上述物业。
actions.text_en: Paradigm REIT was established on 13 March 2025, and the vendors entered into SPAs with RHB Trustee on the same date for the disposal of the subject properties.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年收购 Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd 剩余 30% 股权，使其成为全资子公司。
segments.note_en: This year acquired the remaining 30% equity interest in Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: WCT Land Sdn Bhd 以 RM140,000,000.00 向 EPF 收购 Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd 的 93,000,000 股普通股，相当于其剩余 30% 股权。
actions.text_en: WCT Land Sdn Bhd acquired 93,000,000 ordinary shares in Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd, representing the remaining 30% equity interest, from EPF for RM140,000,000.00.

model_changes.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO (I) PROPOSED DISPOSALS BY THE RESPECTIVE VENDORS OF BUKIT TINGGI SHOPPING CENTRE, PARADIGM MALL PETA
model_changes.text: 通过出售三个购物中心给 Paradigm REIT 并完成该 REIT 的设立与上市，公司将购物中心资产转入 REIT 架构。
model_changes.text_en: Through the disposal of three shopping centres to Paradigm REIT and the completion of the REIT's establishment and listing, the company moved its shopping centre assets into a REIT structure.
